entities.summary: Pairi Daiza is a wildlife immersive destination in Brugelette, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A destination-scale zoological environment distinguished by exceptionally elaborate habitat architecture and landscaping; welfare caveats remain material. This entry is intended for 4–adult travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
entities.whyWorthwhile: A destination-scale zoological environment distinguished by exceptionally elaborate habitat architecture and landscaping; welfare caveats remain material.
